model: MD15-BUS / MD50-BUS small valve actuators (BACnet MS/TP)
applies_to: Kieback&Peter MD15-BUS (-Q, -N-Q, -HE, -N-HE) and MD50-BUS / MD50-BUS-N communicating small valve actuators on BACnet MS/TP or Modbus RTU.
summary: The Kieback&Peter MD15-BUS and MD50-BUS actuators take a position command or run their own control (room, return or differential temperature, or thermal power) over BACnet MS/TP. Objects cover the operating mode and change-over selection, setpoints, PI and limit settings, sensor input configuration for P1/P2, valve selection and hydraulic balancing, flushing and anti-seize timers, actual position, flow, temperatures, thermal power and energy, and status and fault flags.
notes: The source is a German manual; object names are the German parameter names from its data point list (Bezeichnung). The live Object_Name in the actuator may differ.
Many objects exist only on some models (marked "only ..."): power, energy and flow values need the pressure-independent MD15-Q / -N / MD50 types. P1/P2 inputs are not on the -N types.

BI 3-9 are not named in the table; they are bits of the operating status word (register 318) and are listed with the bit text. BI 3 and BI 8 each carry more than one condition (busy/flushing, three limit functions).
MV 8 valve type selection has a different valve list per model; see the manual.
Temperatures written by the BMS (AV 4, AV 5, AV 17) are read-only when a P1/P2 sensor is assigned as their source; the manual says to write them at most once per hour (persistent memory).

source.title: Handbuch Konfiguration und Anwendungsbeispiele MD50-BUS und MD15-BUS-xx (AppNotes), ch. 2.5 Datenpunktliste fuer Bus-Stellantriebe

integration.summary: Pick the operating mode with MV 4 (external position signal or one of the internal control modes) and the heating/cooling change-over with MV 9. In position mode write AV 1 (0-100 %); in room-temperature mode write AV 18 setpoint and the room temperature AV 17. Read AI 6 actual position, AI 7 flow and the fault flags.

minimum_points.name: Betriebmodus
minimum_points.why: Operating mode; 1 = external position signal AV 1

integration.enable: MV 4 Betriebmodus selects position control from AV 1 or an internal control mode; MV 9 sets heating, cooling or shut-off.
integration.heartbeat: MV 6 sets the reaction to a 300 s bus communication loss: no change, close, open, go to the emergency position (AV 8, default 30 %) or follow the 0-10 V input.
integration.remote_sensors: Room (AV 17), supply (AV 4) and return (AV 5) temperatures can be written by the BMS when MV 10 / MV 5 select the bus as their source.
setup: MAC address comes from the DIP switches; with switch setting 63 it can be written through AV 28. MV 7 sets the baud rate (default 38400).
gotchas: MV 6 decides what the actuator does after 300 s without bus communication (no change, close, open, emergency position AV 8, or follow the 0-10 V input).
Write bus temperatures (AV 4, AV 5, AV 17) no more than once an hour; they are stored persistently.
